raw_graphql_pull_request.body: - `stages/moe.py` (`vllm_mx_code`) and `attention/device.py` (`mx_code`) in the DeepSeek-V4 and V4.1 mono decode kernels: when `q = RN(max(amax, FLT_MIN) / 448)` is an f32 subnormal, return code 0 for `q <= 2^-127` and 1 above it, instead of the exponent-bit result, which is always 1 The four copies take the E8M0 scale code from the exponent bits of `q`. Their docstrings, and vLLM's `mxfp8_e4m3_quantize`, give `clamp(ceil(log2 q) + 127, 0, 254)`. For a subnormal `q` the bit trick gives 1, so every group with `amax <= 448 * 2^-127`, including all-zero groups, gets code 1 where vLLM gives 0. The monokernel I/O tests in #63486 catch this, and it blocks that PR. In practice, zero groups (for example a zeroed norm-weight group) only get a different scale byte and still dequantize to 0. bf16-valued inputs never dequantize differently. Only the f32 attention-output quant (XO) could, for groups with amax below 2.6e-36. | amax | q | before | after | vLLM rule (Triton / torch op) | |---|---|---|---|---| | 0 | FLT_MIN / 448 | 1 | 0 | 0 / 0 | | 1e-36 | subnormal | 1 | 0 | 0 / 0 | | 448 * 2^-127 | 2^-127 | 1 | 0 | 0 / 0 | | prev(448 * 2^-126) | rounds to 2^-126 | 1 | 1 | 1 / 1 | | 1.0 | normal | 119 | 119 | 119 / 119 | | check (MI355X) | before | after | |---|---|---| | every non-negative finite f32 amax (2,139,095,040), each of the 4 copies | 73,400,322 wrong codes | 0 | | `test_mono_primitives.py -k scale_codes` (#63486) | 4 failed | 5 passed | | DSv4.1 layer test, hard case with a zeroed norm group | 48 of 7680 codes wrong per quant, 16/16 runs | 0, 10/10 runs | | f32-valued tiny groups, dequantized vs vLLM | 195,270 elements differ | 0 | Decode step time, 20-step CUDA graph, median of interleaved runs (DSv4.1 TP4: 10 runs per arm; DSv4-Pro TP8: pooled runs), with #63576 applied in every DSv4.1 arm: | case | before (us) | after (us) | delta | |---|---|---|---| | DSv4.1 1x1, index source | 75.94 | 76.66 | +0.94% | | DSv4.1 1x6, index source | 102.86 | 103.03 | +0.17% | | DSv4.1 8x6, index source | 314.73 | 314.95 | +0.07% | | DSv4.1 8x6, hard case | 170.75 | 170.67 | -0.05% | | DSv4-Pro 1x1 | 90.69 | 90.79 | +0.11% | | DSv4-Pro 1x7 | 124.45 | 124.41 | -0.03% | | DSv4-Pro 64x1 | 412.24 | 412.84 | +0.15% | An unchanged-code control arm moved -0.21% to +0.11% on DSv4-Pro and +0.10 us on DSv4.1. The one case outside that is DSv4.1 at one row with an index source: +0.7 us in two 5-round sets and +0.3 us in a follow-up. The same step without the index source doesn't move, and K1's eager device time is unchanged (18.22 vs 18.05 us). AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to draft this change. Every line was reviewed by the submitter. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.
